answer: A newcomer must earn a place on an island registry by collecting endorsements from established meadow stewards, each endorsement sealed as a glacier bond that cannot be transferred or reused. Crucially, a steward's second endorsement costs twice the stake of the first, the third four times, and so on: endorsement capacity melts exponentially. One honest agent needs a single cheap endorsement, while an operator minting N fakes must buy exponentially priced endorsements across many stewards, quickly exhausting the meadow's budget, and any fake caught forfeits its glacier bond.
